doc: Every named book's chapters, verses and what each verse covers, without a parse.

envelope.doc: The header, then the directory, then each book's rows, then the ids.

fields.name: magic
fields.doc: `TOCS`, little-endian.

fields.name: version
fields.doc: FORMAT_VERSION. A reader that does not know it stops.

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: Bit 0: every offset is UTF-16 rather than a byte.

fields.name: bookCount
fields.doc: Directory entries: one per registered book asked for.

fields.name: chapterStride
fields.doc: Bytes per Chapter row, as written.

fields.name: verseStride
fields.doc: Bytes per Verse row, as written.

fields.name: memberStride
fields.doc: Bytes per Member row, as written.

fields.name: directoryAt
fields.doc: Where the directory starts, so the header may grow.

envelope.doc: One book's entry: where its three row blocks are, and how many rows each has.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: The `\id` line's book code, ASCII.

fields.name: terminator
fields.doc: NUL, the shape the Sous directory reads a code in too.

fields.name: chaptersAt
fields.doc: Where this book's Chapter rows start.

fields.name: chapterRows
fields.doc: How many; row 0 is the front matter.

fields.name: versesAt
fields.doc: Where this book's Verse rows start.

fields.name: verseRows
fields.doc: How many.

fields.name: idAt
fields.doc: Where the caller's id for this book starts, in the trailing ids.

fields.name: idLen
fields.doc: Its bytes of UTF-8.

fields.name: membersAt
fields.doc: Where this book's Member rows start.

fields.name: memberRows
fields.doc: How many.

envelope.doc: One chapter's extent, its number, and what its verses count to.
One verse anchor and the range of verse numbers it names.
One member of a verse designator: a place, or a range joined by `-`.
Every book's id as the caller registered it, UTF-8, unpadded.

records.name: Chapter
records.doc: One chapter's extent, its number, and what its verses count to.

fields.name: start
fields.doc: First byte of the `\c` marker; 0 on the front-matter row.

fields.name: end
fields.doc: One past the chapter's last byte. Rows TILE the book.

fields.name: number
fields.doc: The number read, or 0 — absent, malformed, or row 0's front matter.

fields.name: labelStart
fields.doc: The designator as written (`12b`). Empty at the marker's end when there is none; 0..0 on the front-matter row.

fields.name: labelEnd
fields.doc: Where the label ends.

fields.name: anchors
fields.doc: How many `\v` markers sit inside this chapter's span, saturating.

fields.name: lastVerse
fields.doc: The highest verse number those anchors name; 0 when none does. A bridge `\v 5-7` is one anchor reaching 7 — so this is the count that keys by NUMBER where `anchors` counts MARKERS.

records.name: Verse
records.doc: One verse anchor and the range of verse numbers it names.

fields.name: at
fields.doc: First byte of the `\v` marker.

fields.name: chapter
fields.doc: The number of the chapter row whose span CONTAINS this anchor — position, never the designator.

fields.name: first
fields.doc: Lowest verse named; 0 when the designator is absent or malformed.

fields.name: last
fields.doc: Highest named — equal to `first` unless this is a bridge or a list. `first..last` is the HULL; the members are what it covers.

fields.name: labelStart
fields.doc: The designator as written (`6a`, `1,3,5`). Empty at the marker's end when there is none.

fields.name: labelEnd
fields.doc: Where the label ends.

fields.name: membersFrom
fields.doc: This verse's first row in the book's member block.

fields.name: membersLen
fields.doc: How many members it covers; 0 when the designator is absent or malformed.

records.name: Member
records.doc: One member of a verse designator: a place, or a range joined by `-`.

fields.name: from
fields.doc: The member's first number.

fields.name: fromSegmentStart
fields.doc: The segment written after it (`a` in `12a`); empty when none.

fields.name: fromSegmentEnd
fields.doc: Where that segment ends.

fields.name: to
fields.doc: Its last number; equal to `from` for a single place. Kept as written.

fields.name: toSegmentStart
fields.doc: The segment after the last number; empty when none.

fields.name: toSegmentEnd
fields.doc: Where that segment ends.
